description: Step-based explanation tool for Grade 7 Mathematics — Distributive Property Explorer. Two-column layout walking students through a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c with simultaneous LHS/RHS computation, sign rule highlighting, and worked examples using integers.
topic: Sign Rules for Multiple Factors and Distributive Property
subject: Mathematics

leftColumn.label: Left Hand Side (LHS)
leftColumn.description: Shows the direct computation path: simplify the bracket first, then multiply

rightColumn.label: Right Hand Side (RHS)
rightColumn.description: Shows the expanded computation path: distribute multiplication over each term, then add

layout.divider: Vertical equals sign between columns, turns green and thick on confirmation step

designSpecification.responsiveness: Mobile-responsive with horizontal scroll for two-column layout on small screens

animations.amberGlow: Numerical values glow in amber at computation steps
animations.confirmBanner: Property Confirmed banner with bounce animation
animations.signRuleHighlight: Purple glow animation on negative × negative = positive

autoPlayDuration.description: Auto-advance delay in ms (0 = manual only)

additionalProps.description: Tool-specific dynamic content for customizing examples and features

c.description: Second addend inside bracket (can be negative)

examples.description: Array of examples. Each has a, b, c for a × (b + c). Steps are auto-generated.

showTokenModel.description: Show token-based visual proof alongside algebraic steps

highlightSignRules.description: Highlight sign rules (negative × negative = positive) during expansion

diwaliContext.description: Include Diwali budget context in step narrations

structure.description: Shows the full equation to verify, with context narrative

structure.lhs: Simplify the bracket (b + c) — highlighted in a box
structure.rhs: Show expanded form a × b + a × c with terms highlighted in green/red
structure.description: First operation: bracket simplification vs expansion

structure.rhs: Compute each term separately, with sign rule badges
structure.description: Numerical computation with amber glow. Sign rules highlighted for negative × negative
Both sides equal — thick green equals sign, Property Confirmed! banner

teachingNotes.simultaneousAdvancement: Both LHS and RHS advance together for maximum 'both roads lead to the same answer' impact
teachingNotes.signRuleHighlight: At Example 2 Step 2, (−2) × (−3) = +6 is highlighted in purple with sparkle icon to reinforce negative × negative = positive
teachingNotes.followUpChallenge: After tool completion, students are asked to verify (−4) × (2 + (−3)) in their notebook — mirrors textbook challenge
teachingNotes.tokenModelConnection: Optionally use the token arrangement from textbook page 41 as visual proof before this tool

studentInstructions.watch: Observe both LHS and RHS being worked out simultaneously
studentInstructions.notice: At Step 2 for each example, notice sign rules during expansion — especially (−2) × (−3) in Example 2
studentInstructions.predict: At each step, predict: will the two sides match?
studentInstructions.reflect: After both examples, state the distributive property in your own words
